column3: MT 92:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “in the nights” is rendered “by night.”
“On a ten” is rendered “the ten-stringed lute,” and “on a melody” (higgaion) as “with resounding music.”
Close to the Hebrew; “by your deeds” is rendered “by what You have done.”
NASB links this verse to verse 6 with “That” and adds “It was only”; “vegetation” is rendered “grass.”
Close to the Hebrew; “[you are] height” is rendered “are on high.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “that of” (“like that of the wild ox”).
NASB adds “exultantly” to “my eye has looked,” and renders “my ears have heard” as present “hear of.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fat and fresh” is rendered “full of sap and very green.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “He is” before “my rock.”
